x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Decision.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern, mirroring the fragment-55 citesGoverningDocuments delta): this fragment merges ONLY the optional meeting and agendaItem join properties onto the existing decision schema. Neither is required and no existing property is modified, so decisions created before this change stay valid. Declares the join that MeetingDecisionsTab.vue and AgendaMotionsTab.vue already write silently today, so OpenRegister validates the write instead of silently accepting an undeclared field.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Optional reference to the Meeting this decision was taken in. Written by MeetingDecisionsTab.vue when a decision is created from a meeting's decisions tab. Empty for decisions created outside a meeting flow (e.g. a citizen-panel or nomination decision).

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem this decision resolves. Written by AgendaMotionsTab.vue when a decision (motion) is created from an agenda item's motions tab. Empty for decisions not tied to a specific agenda item.

Person.description: An individual person who participates in governance. Popolo: Person. Identity only: organisational role/relationship lives on Membership (ADR-001 §2). Replaces the flat Participant. Carries an optional nextcloudUserId (judge amendment, 2026-08-19, design.md Data-migration section): the Nextcloud account linkage carried over from the retired Participant shim, so the code chain's Participant-to-Person crosswalk has a strong identity key (match order: nextcloudUserId exact -> email exact -> create new) instead of relying on email heuristics alone.

nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud user
nextcloudUserId.description: Optional Nextcloud user ID (login name / UID) of the Nextcloud user this Person represents. Carried over from Participant.nextcloudUserId by the code chain's crosswalk repair step (model-debt-cleanup-code) so vote-casting, proxy delegation, and vote-link personalisation keep a strong identity key once a Participant is retired in favour of Person + Membership.

ConflictOfInterest.description: A declared or detected conflict-of-interest disclosure per MCCG / governance code. As of this change, boardMember references Membership, not the deprecated Participant shim: a conflict-of-interest declaration is inherently a statement about a person's role/relationship in a specific governance body, and Membership already carries independenceStatus, the exact MCCG-adjacent field a COI declaration is evaluated against.

boardMember.title: Board member
boardMember.description: UUID of the Membership (the board member's role/relationship in this governance body) declaring the conflict of interest (was Participant).

Participant.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by Person + Membership (ADR-001 §2). Retained as a narrowed shim for exactly four remaining consumers: the Meeting quorum aggregation (totalParticipantCount/presentParticipantCount), VotingService:resolveParticipantUuid, Vote.participant, and EngagementRecord.participant. As of this change, ConflictOfInterest.boardMember and ProxyAuthorization.grantor/holder no longer reference Participant (retargeted to Membership/Person respectively: 024). A member or attendee of a governance body.

BoardProxy.description: RETIRED: superseded by ProxyAuthorization + its proxyStatus property, which now carries this schema's approval-workflow concept (pending-approval -> active -> suspended/revoked). Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete: false, existing rows), but no new BoardProxy rows should be created, use ProxyAuthorization instead. Historical description: a proxy (volmacht) granted by one board member to another for a single meeting; the row ProxyVoteService wrote through /api/proxies and the row the per-holder proxy cap counted; the signed-document side of a volmacht lives on ProxyAuthorization.
